item.title: The Bloop Add-On
item.creator: Mythicus
item.description:
The Bloop is hunting you in the oceans of your world! Experience:
- A new DIMENSION INSIDE the Bloop.
- Advanced mob AI (You will be hunted, haunted, jumpscared and everything in between)
- Whole NEW ocean villages (and your ocean house) CAN be EATEN
- Deep ocean trench biomes
- Deep sea equipment, new enchantments, and a boss fight
Get this Add-On and scare your friends!

faqEntries.heading: How do I find the ocean village / underwater village?
faqEntries.content: Ocean villages generate naturally in deep ocean biomes. Using a world seed with a large ocean near spawn gives the best odds of finding one quickly.

faqEntries.heading: If I get pulled into the Bloop's dimension, can I dig out?
faqEntries.content: No, the Bloop's dimension is enclosed and you cannot dig your way out. You'll need to survive and find the intended escape mechanic.

faqEntries.heading: Is the Bloop addon compatible with other addons?
faqEntries.content: Addon compatibility varies. For the best experience, test with one addon at a time. Check our Discord for community-reported compatible addon combinations.

faqEntries.heading: Why does the Bloop disappear before it reaches me?
faqEntries.content: This is an intended mechanic called the bloop mirage. It is meant to be the bloop's soul haunting you.

item.howToTitle: How do I encounter The Bloop?

howToEntries.content:
The bloop spawns mostly in our deep sea ocean biomes. At first it will be very passive, and progressively over time it will become more agreessive.

The bloop has different behaviors that are triggered randomly during normal gameplay. The behavior is influenced by the aggression level of the bloop which increases more based on the time the player spends in the water. Aggression level can be increased to 100 (its maximum) by throwing a Fishy Offering in the bloop altar. You can not damage or kill the bloop externally.
All of the abilities the bloop has will trigger a custom fog and an audio event so the player knows something is happening. 

In order to aggrevate the bloop naturally, use submarines, swim in our custom deep ocean biomes, and fight the deep sea mobs that lurk within. Time spent in this biome will impact this!

howToEntries.heading: What is the Bloop Dimension?
howToEntries.content: The bloop dimension is where you go when you have been eaten by the bloop. Currently the only way out is to defeat the bloop soul which lurks at the end of the dungeon. You will come across various structures that you can loot as you progress through the dimension.
